summary: Live Expo smoke and backend API regression passed. Speak screen loaded at 390x844, mic tap entered Listening without a red screen, task returned alternatives, and sorting preserved every input item.
action_items: Run a native Android recording/session retest to verify microphone upload and end-card flows, which cannot be completed reliably in this web smoke run.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend resolves EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (and an Expo extra key) rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL name; current configured environment works, but naming should remain intentional and documented.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (load, mic tap, no red screen); full session/card not executed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview passed initial speak/mic smoke at 390x844. Backend task produced 2 alternatives and sort preserved all 3 supplied items, defaulting unmatched items to LATER. Native recording, delayed Start, Not this one?, unlimited captures, timer completion, card ordering, and PNG contents remain unverified.
rca_of_issue: Initial pytest failures were test-environment setup failures: the test read EXPO_BACKEND_URL, but that variable was not exported to the shell while the configured frontend env contains EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Loading /app/frontend/.env in the regression test resolved the invalid '/api/' URL; all 3 tests then passed. No product failure was observed.
